name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section IX – European Data Protection Supervisor
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Data Protection Supervisor spent its 2024 budget of about 24.3 million euros. The report is mostly a set of comments and requests, not new law. Parliament asks the Supervisor to handle complaints faster, to be clearer about travel costs paid by others, and to get enough money and staff for its new job of supervising artificial intelligence under the Artificial Intelligence Act.

- Parliament grants budget approval for 2024 and asks for faster complaint handling.
- Affects the European Data Protection Supervisor, its staff and people who complain to it.
- Next: the Supervisor must report back on complaints, travel costs and artificial intelligence staffing.
